# A Synthetic Randomized Trial of Structured Small-Group Tutoring

Avery Synthetic, Jordan Fixture (2025). SYNTHETIC FIXTURE, not a real publication.

## Abstract
This synthetic document describes a fictional randomized trial of structured small-group tutoring, used only to test literature-review integrity tooling.

## Methods
Students in the synthetic sample were randomly assigned to structured small-group tutoring or to business-as-usual instruction for one academic term. The outcome was a standardized end-of-term mathematics post-test.

## Results
Relative to the comparison group, mean post-test scores in the tutoring group improved by 7.3 percent at the end of the term.

## Limitations
Because this is a synthetic fixture, the sample, setting, and effect are invented and carry no external validity.
